first_failure_signal: aid applicant cannot prove ownership, occupancy, tenancy, or right to return after records are lost or informal
minimum_control: multiple proof paths plus legal aid denial code and appeal

first_failure_signal: repeated-loss households are told to rebuild while buyout or relocation is slow, opaque, or owner-only
minimum_control: voluntary buyout and no-rebuild review with tenant support and destination capacity

first_failure_signal: urgent contracts are awarded fast but files, prices, conflicts, monitoring, or complaint paths are missing
minimum_control: emergency waiver with trigger scope price check conflict disclosure and sunset

first_failure_signal: eligible work stalls because the applicant lacks liquidity, match, documentation, staff, or audit-ready files
minimum_control: cost-capture system plus match bridge and audit file pull

first_failure_signal: rebuilding is either unsafe because codes are weak or exclusionary because upgrades are unfunded
minimum_control: current hazard-resistant code plus permit surge and upgrade finance

first_failure_signal: crews, inspectors, nurses, operators, and caseworkers cannot report safely or sustain work
minimum_control: lodging childcare PPE work-rest payroll credentials and family support

first_failure_signal: residents cannot repair what landlords, park owners, condo boards, HOAs, or shared-infrastructure owners control
minimum_control: governance classification and common-asset repair/finance path

first_failure_signal: programs close while households still lack safe housing, documents, repairs, health support, income, or appeals
minimum_control: case-management closure ledger with reopen and public residual-need dashboard
